content.ascii:
OpenCode session engine: host-scoped composition
|
|-- Session.Service: public boundary
|   |-- Session.make(): shared-service closures
|   |   `-- forSession(id): ID-bound handles; read current stored state
|   |       |-- get / messages / inbox -> durable readers
|   |       |-- prompt: reconcile ID -> prepare -> admit
|   |       |   |-- -> Instance.provide(session) for preparation
|   |       |   |-- Commit staged revert only after preparation succeeds
|   |       |   `-- -> SessionExecution.wake unless resume === false
|   |       |-- resume / interrupt / wait -> SessionExecution
|   |       `-- revert / compact / permissions / agent / model controls
|   |-- create / fork / move / list
|   |   `-- -> publish changes or read projected state
|   |-- remove: interrupt -> awaitIdle -> cancel jobs -> close transport
|   |   `-- Delete parent, then recursively remove children
|   `-- log -> Bus aggregate history; requires retained event payloads
|
|-- SessionExecution: process-local execution owner
|   |-- SessionRunCoordinator
|   |   |-- executions: Map<sessionID, Execution>
|   |   |   `-- Execution: one busy period per session
|   |   |       |-- owner fiber + done Deferred
|   |   |       `-- pendingWake / scope / stopping / interruptionReason
|   |   |-- wake coalesces; run starts or joins; sessions run concurrently
|   |   |-- started hook -> Bus: Started + durable claim atomically
|   |   `-- settled hook -> terminal publication after cleanup
|   |       `-- awaitIdle includes settlement and late-wake successors
|   |-- drain dispatch -> Instance.provide(session) -> SessionRunner
|   |   `-- Moved / Reloaded: reload session, reacquire graph, continue
|   `-- SubagentReport helper
|       |-- -> shared Job generations and durable report outbox
|       `-- Terminal commit releases claim; delivery -> parent inbox + wake
|
|-- SessionRestart: separately invoked startup recovery service
|   `-- -> orphan claims + retry budget + owed reports; at-least-once
|
|-- Durable state and publication subsystem
|   `-- Shared Bus / SessionProjector / SessionStore / SessionInbox / SQL
|
|-- LocationServiceMap: shared cache keyed by canonical Location.Ref
|   `-- Instance.provide(session) borrows the session's location graph
|
|-- SessionModelTransport: global service with session-bound transport
`-- Job: shared execution generations and completion-report storage
